show.name: Beavis and Butt-Head
show.summary: A national treasure in an age of idiocy… When Beavis and Butt-Head first appeared on MTV more than a decade ago, critics dismissed them as brainless couch potatoes who did nothing but watch TV and make lewd jokes about bodily functions. Today we know they were ahead of their time. Beavis and Butt-Head's unique idiocy profoundly changed television, movies, pop culture and the world.

episodes.title: Door-to-Door
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head must participate in Mr. Van Driessen's 60's experiment, so they set out to go door-to-door. While they are out the boys meet someone unexpected.

episodes.title: Give Blood
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head want money, so they donate their blood to a charity blood bank

episodes.title: Balloon
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head go to the aquarium with helium filled balloons.

episodes.title: Scientific Stuff
episodes.summary: Mrs. Dickie shows how unimpressed she is with Beavis and Butt-Head's science project, she forces them to work on a new project with Daria Morgendorffer.

episodes.title: Good Credit
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head run up charges on Mr. Anderson's credit card at a pet shop.

episodes.title: Burger World
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head's incompetence forces Mr. Anderson to wait in the Burger World drive-thru.

episodes.title: Baby Makes Uh, Three
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head must work together to care for a sugar sack "baby" because none of the girls in class want to partner up with them.

episodes.title: Beware of the Butt
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head cause trouble a drive-in movie theater.

episodes.title: At the Sideshow
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head attend a freak show and try to score with the Rubber Band Lady.

episodes.title: Customers Suck
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head mistreat the customers at Burger World.

episodes.title: Sick
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head see a doctor after getting sick, hoping to score some powerful cold medicine.

episodes.title: Home Improvement
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head are hired by Mr. Anderson to paint his house

episodes.title: Way Down Mexico Way (1)
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head take a trip to Mexico and on their way back to the States they are questioned by border agents

episodes.title: Way Down Mexico Way (2)
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head take a trip to Mexico and on their way back to the States they are questioned by border agents.

episodes.title: At the Movies
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-head ransack the drive-in movie theater and take all the concessions.

episodes.title: No Laughing (1)
episodes.summary: Principal McVicker attempts a radical solution to Beavis and Butt-Head's stupidity and continuous laughing in class: they cannot laugh at anything they hear for a week, or risk being expelled and sent to a different high school.

episodes.title: No Laughing (2)
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head struggle hugely to avoid laughing during Buzzcut's sexual education class.

episodes.title: The Butt-Head Experience
episodes.summary: During a boring day at Burger World, Butt-Head falls asleep and dreams about being in a rock band with Beavis.

episodes.title: Lawn & Garden
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head are ordered to prune the top of Mr. Anderson's tree, but take a disastrous shortcut on their job by sawing through the trunk. The tree falls on his house and power lines, which fells utility poles onto parked cars.

episodes.title: Stewart's House
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head go to Stewart's house to watch a pay-per-view special, but get bored with it and cause chaos inside the house.

episodes.title: For Better or Verse
episodes.summary: Mr. Van Driessen makes Beavis and Butt-Head write haikus in class.

episodes.title: Bedpans & Broomsticks
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head torment a post-heart surgery patient, Billy Bob, by stealing his scooter and crashing it.

episodes.title: Babes R Us
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head try out for a mud wrestling act at the local strip club, but are turned down because they are underage.

episodes.title: Yogurt's Cool
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head buy frozen yogurt but are unimpressed by the taste of it. When refused a refund, they take a messy revenge on the mall.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head go to a skeet shooting range, where they cause a Boeing 747 to crash by firing too high into the air.

episodes.title: Washing the Dog
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head volunteer to wash Mr. Anderson's dog in hopes that he would leave them money in his will.

episodes.title: Friday Night
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head hang out at Maxi-Mart in an attempt to pick up chicks and meet a biker chick who uses them to shoplift.

episodes.title: Be All You Can Be
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head ponder enlisting in the U.S. Army as "Major Woody" and "Private Parts", but run afoul of Col. Dick Leakey. The boys end up causing havoc with some bullets and an active grenade.

episodes.title: Comedians
episodes.summary: The duo go to a comedy club where Butt-Head's stand-up comedy fails. When Beavis takes his turn on stage, he sets fire to the building after burning newspapers with which to juggle.

episodes.title: Car Wash
episodes.summary: The two are hired to wash a Chevrolet Corvair in order to pay for new TV remote batteries, but decide to take it for a ride. They stop on a junction, where another car crashes into it.

episodes.title: Couch-Fishing
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head create a dangerous and illegal hobby with a fishing pole and the junk found deep in the cracks of their sofa.

episodes.title: Incognito
episodes.summary: Under threat of possible death from Earl, a gun-holding classmate, the duo assume ridiculous disguises and pretend to be exchange students. When someone outside the class fires at them, the two exonerate Earl, and in gratitude, Earl spares their lives.

episodes.title: Kidnapped
episodes.summary: The duo conceive a plot to kidnap Stewart for ransom so they can attend a heavy metal concert.

episodes.title: Naked Colony
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head, upon discovering the concept of a nudist colony, attempt to join one. They cannot afford the membership fee, so they climb over the wall.

episodes.title: Tornado
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head bike to a trailer park to check out a tornado.

episodes.title: Cleaning House
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head are hired by Mr. Van Driessen to clean his house, but the duo end up destroying his entire 8-track tape collection.

episodes.title: Scratch 'N' Win
episodes.summary: The duo get a dollar and win $500 by buying a lottery ticket. They then buy a riding mower, which they use to cut a circle-A in the lawn in front of Highland High School.

episodes.title: Scared Straight
episodes.summary: McVicker restarts a Scared Straight program and the duo find themselves having fun in prison.

episodes.title: Eating Contest
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head enter a bratwurst-eating contest. They are unaware of and unable to pay the entrance fee, so they have to work with frogs to pay it.

episodes.title: Sporting Goods
episodes.summary: Coach Buzzcut orders Beavis and Butt-Head to buy jockstraps for gym class because neither of them have any. The store's smallest supporters are too big for both of them, so they are given eyepatches instead, which Daria writes about in the school paper.

episodes.title: Sperm Bank
episodes.summary: The duo sell sperm at the offices of Dr. Rod Johnson, and buy porn magazines with the money.

episodes.title: Buff 'N' Stuff
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head are so muscularly atrophied that they are forced to stay after gym class for a personal workout with Coach Buzzcut.

episodes.title: Citizen Butt-Head
episodes.summary: President Bill Clinton is about to visit Highland High, so McVicker does his best to keep Beavis and Butt-Head preoccupied by sending the boys off-campus.

episodes.title: Politically Correct
episodes.summary: The duo accidentally run for student office and receive one vote.

episodes.title: Ball Breakers
episodes.summary: The duo take to bowling as their latest activity. While there, they steal Mr. Anderson's bowling ball, put firecrackers in it and drop it from the roof of the building onto the street. Anderson is arrested for the 'bombing'.

episodes.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Meet God
episodes.summary: The duo try to score chicks while hitchhiking and are picked up by a religious cult who takes them to meet "God", their leader.

episodes.title: True Crime
episodes.summary: Various crime documentary television shows report on Beavis and Butt-Head's theft of money from a cash machine.

episodes.title: The Trial
episodes.summary: Butt-Head must defend himself and Beavis in court after both are charged with vandalizing Anderson's property.

episodes.title: The Crush
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head become infatuated with a bully named Todd and attempt to join his gang.

episodes.title: Plate Frisbee
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head go to Stewart's house, where they pick up an antique plate belonging to Stewart's mother. They go outside and use it as a frisbee.

episodes.title: Canoe
episodes.summary: Van Driessen takes the duo and Stewart on a canoe trip. At their camp, Beavis and Butt-Head use poison ivy as toilet paper and a bear attacks Van Driessen.

episodes.title: Young, Gifted & Crude
episodes.summary: Mistaken for geniuses, Beavis and Butt-Head are placed in advanced classes at Highland High.

episodes.title: Foreign Exchange
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head befriend, and influence, a foreign exchange student from Japan.

episodes.title: Closing Time
episodes.summary: Beavis and Butt-Head must deal with a health inspector after making a gigantic mess at Burger World.

episodes.title: Most Wanted
episodes.summary: Extended episode. An escaped mental patient hides from the authorities at Butt-Head's house.

episodes.title: They're Coming to Take Me Away, Huh Huh
Beavis, Can You Spare a Dime?
The Future of Beavis and Butt-Head
